 Emily Salley
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 13:38 GMT 13:38 GMT 
 HT: Chelsea 1-1 Everton 
 Zero shots on target from Everton, but they find themselves level with Sonia Bompastor's side after Sandy Baltimore's opener.
 2 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:36 GMT 13:36 GMT 
 Man City 1-0 West Ham 
 Manchester City, as things stand, head into the break at the top of the WSL table.
 West Ham are still very much in it, though.
 11 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 13:35 GMT 13:35 GMT 
 Man City 1-0 West Ham 
 Sillly that from Viviane Asseyi.
 She crashes into the back of Kerstin Casparij and the referee wastes no time in reaching for her pocket to pull out a yellow card.
 4 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:33 GMT 13:33 GMT 
 HT: Chelsea 1-1 Everton 
 Helen Ward 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 
 It's been pretty entertaining.
 Chelsea have dominated the ball but as we know, anything can happen in football and they find themselves level at the break.
 10 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:33 GMT 13:33 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-1 Everton 
 Yuka Momiki makes a superb run to the edge of Chelsea's box and sends a Blues defender to the floor, but she lifts the shot just over the bar.
 And that will be that. All square at the break. 
 5 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:30 GMT 13:30 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-1 Everton 
 Hannah Blundell is having a fantastic game for Everton so far.
 Yet another crucial block to stop Melvine Malard from nipping in and she's been a threat going forward, too.
 12 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Who else? published at 13:28 GMT 13:28 GMT 
 Man City 1-0 West Ham 
 Sophia Hartley 
BBC Radio 5live at the Joie Stadium 
 Are we surprised at this point? Bunny Shaw gets a 10th goal in nine games. Remarkable. 
 She's just under halfway to her 21 goals from last season. 
 25 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:28 GMT 13:28 GMT 
 Man City 1-0 West Ham 
 Khadija Shaw has now scored in each of the past nine WSL games she has started in. An incredible stat.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 24 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 13:27 GMT 13:27 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-1 Everton 
 Just moments after scoring an own goal, Lucy Bronze almost makes up for her mistake with a goal at the other end. She's unmarked in the box and it's a free header, but she sends it straight onto the crossbar.
 13 17 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:26 GMT 13:26 GMT 
 Man City 1-0 West Ham 
 Helen Ward 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 
 I love watching Bunny Shaw play. She scores all types of goals - poaching, tap-ins, headers, one on ones and occasionally the spectacular.
 She is absolutely relentless.
 30 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Man City 1-0 West Ham published at 13:25 GMT 13:25 GMT 
 Khadija Shaw 
 Breakthrough!
 It's a great team goal and it's expertly finished by Khadija Shaw .
 Lauren Hemps sneaks in and steals possession in the middle of the park as West Ham try to play out from the back and City work it brilliantly up to Shaw, who slots past Constance Picaud-Inconnu.
 88 57 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:22 GMT 13:22 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page 
 Image source, Getty Images Sandy Baltimore is a fabulous player - not just her goalscoring and dribbling ability but a couple of her first touches to control the ball are world class.
 Terence, Italy 
 52 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:21 GMT 13:21 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-1 Everton 
 Another header wasted by Melvine Malard. She just couldn't get enough power on that one and it loops into the gloves of Courtney Brosnan.
 8 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:20 GMT 13:20 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-1 Everton 
 Helen Ward 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 
 That's come out of absolutely nowhere!
 Lucy Bronze was all on her own, but misreads the ball and gets herself all in a tangle. It's beyond Hannah Hampton before she even realises.
 I'm speechless as I don't know where that has come from.
 26 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Chelsea 1-1 Everton published at 13:18 GMT 13:18 GMT 
 Lucy Bronze (own goal) 
 Lucy Bronze , on her 150th WSL appearance, plants the ball into her own net.
 It's a brilliant ball in from Yuka Momiki, but it can't find one of her Everton team-mates and it takes an unfortunate deflection off Bronze to wrongfoot Hannah Hampton.
 107 103 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Only a matter of time for Chelsea' published at 13:15 GMT 13:15 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-0 Everton 
 Helen Ward 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 
 A really well-worked set-piece from Chelsea. 
 Lucy Bronze sends a wonderfully cushioned header across the goal, takes Courtney Brosnan out of the game and Sandy Baltimore, who isn't the biggest player on the pitch, finds the space to head home.
 With all the talent and experience they've got in their team, it was only a matter of time before they scored.
 37 17 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Chelsea 1-0 Everton published at 13:15 GMT 13:15 GMT 
 Sandy Baltimore 
 Image source, Getty Images Straight from the training ground.
 Chelsea play a short corner and Katie McCabe works up an angle to whip the ball towards the back post, where Lucy Bronze is waiting to head it back across the face of goal.
 All Sandy Baltimore has to do is get her head on it.
 67 24 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 13:13 GMT 13:13 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 West Ham 
 It looks like Aoba Fujino has space to direct her shot across Constance Picaud-Inconnu, but she turns and blasts her strike off the near post.
 4 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:12 GMT 13:12 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Everton 
 Helen Ward 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 
 Chelsea are just starting to turn the screw now.
 It's Ellie Carpenter again at the heart of most of their good things. They are starting to turn it up now and it feels like a goal could be coming any minute.
 18 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 13:12 GMT 13:12 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Everton 
 Hannah Blundell keeps Everton level, getting back to make a sublime goalline clearance and deny Wieke Kaptein.
